title: EGR3 deletion attenuates developmental and epileptic encephalopathy in Kcna1 -null mice
title_zh: EGR3缺失减轻Kcna1-缺失小鼠的发育性癫痫性脑病
abstract: Abstract KCNA1 encodes the α-subunit of the voltage-gated potassium channel KV1.1. Mutations in KV1.1’s pore domain result in developmental and epileptic encephalopathy (DEE), where early life seizures and a culprit lesion synergistically disrupt neurodevelopmental trajectories, resulting in intellectual disability that often presents with disturbances in sleep, sociability and sensory processing. Abnormalities in the subcellular localization of Kv1.1, via mutations in/autoantibodies against LGI1 and CNTNAP2, also give rise to syndromes of epilepsy and neuropsychiatric impairment. Mice with deletions of Kcna1(“-/-“) are known to display spontaneous seizures at 2-3 weeks of age and premature mortality. In this study, we applied instrumented home-cage monitoring to examine how aberrations in KCNA1 expression may result in pervasive alterations in spontaneous behavior. Compared to wildtype, Kcna1-/- mice displayed a robust multifaceted behavioral syndrome featuring marked nocturnal hyperactivity, reduced sleep and sheltering, fragmented feeding/drinking rhythms, abnormal sensory responsivity and diminished wheel-running. In similar recordings, Kcna1+/- mice only displayed increased sheltering, Lgi1+/- mice displayed mild sleep reductions and Cntnap2-/- mice showed home-cage hypoactivity. Kcna1 loss in parvalbumin-positive interneurons (PV-Cre) resulted in a subtle phenocopy, with mild reductions in sleep accompanied by reduced sheltering behavior, while Kcna1 deletions in forebrain pyramidal neurons (Emx1-Cre) or dopaminergic neurons (DAT-Cre) were asymptomatic. Adult-onset conditional deletions of Kcna1 also produced only mild sleep loss 6 weeks later. To survey the molecular landscape in Kcna1-/- mice, we conducted a mass spectrometry proteomic analysis of dissected hippocampal tissue (a predominant seizure onset zone and where astrogliosis is observed). This revealed significant upregulations in brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) and the immediate early transcription factor, early growth response-3 (EGR3), which is necessary for the induction of BDNF following electroconvulsive seizures. Heterozygous or homozygous deletions of Egr3 in Kcna1-/- mice resulted in significant survival prolongation, a partial suppression of neurobehavioral impairments, and a significant reduction in the frequency of spontaneous seizures and spreading depolarization events. These phenotypic corrections were associated with an amelioration of BDNF induction, hippocampal astrogliosis and proteomic disturbances. Together, these data demonstrate how disruptions to an ion channel that governs neuronal excitability at millisecond timescales can pleiotropically alter spontaneous behavior over much longer time scales. Our results provide a model and a set of precision endpoints to understand how ictal and interictal features of DEE may manifest through long-term transcriptional alterations imparted by early life seizures.
abstract_zh: 摘要：KCNA1编码电压门控钾通道KV1.1的α亚基。KV1.1孔道域突变可导致发育性癫痫性脑病（DEE），早期癫痫发作与致病病灶共同破坏神经发育轨迹，导致智力障碍，常伴睡眠、社交和感官处理紊乱。通过突变或针对LGI1和CNTNAP2的自身抗体导致Kv1.1亚细胞定位异常，也可引起癫痫和神经精神障碍综合征。Kcna1（-/-）小鼠已知在2-3周龄时出现自发癫痫并提前死亡。本研究使用仪器化家庭笼监测，探讨KCNA1表达异常如何导致自发行为的广泛改变。与野生型相比，Kcna1-/-小鼠表现出强烈多面行为综合征，特点是夜间过度活跃、睡眠和避难减少、进食/饮水节律碎片化、感官反应异常以及跑轮运动减少。在类似记录中，Kcna1+/-小鼠仅表现出避难增加，Lgi1+/-小鼠轻度睡眠减少，Cntnap2-/-小鼠表现为笼内低活性。PV-Cre介导的Kcna1在视紫红质阳性抑制神经元中的缺失产生了细微的表型仿真，伴随轻度睡眠减少和避难行为下降；而在前脑锥体神经元（Emx1-Cre）或多巴胺能神经元（DAT-Cre）中的Kcna1缺失无症状。成年后条件性Kcna1缺失在6周后仅导致轻度睡眠缺失。为调查Kcna1-/-小鼠的分子景观，我们对解剖的海马组织（癫痫发作起始区和星形胶质增生显著的区域）进行质谱蛋白组学分析。结果显示脑源性神经营养因子（BDNF）和即时早期转录因子早期生长反应-3（EGR3）显著上调，EGR3是电击性癫痫后BDNF诱导所必需的。Kcna1-/-小鼠中Egr3的杂合或纯合缺失显著延长生存期，部分抑制神经行为缺陷，并显著降低自发癫痫和扩散去极化事件的频率。这些表型修正与BDNF诱导、海马星形胶质增生和蛋白组失衡的改善相关。综上所述，这些数据展示了调控毫秒级神经元兴奋性的离子通道失调如何多效性地改变更长时间尺度的自发行为。本研究提供了一个模型和一组精准终点，用于理解DEE的发作期和间歇期特征如何通过早期癫痫发作引起的长期转录改变表现出来。
